patch_description: This version redesigns placement around a compact indexed state representation and a lexicographic KVPR objective. Instead of only accepting moves that immediately reduce the maximum KVPR, local search also accepts controlled plateau moves that keep the maximum unchanged while improving the second-, third-, and lower-ranked GPU pressures. This helps escape memory-fragmentation local minima without random perturbation. Multiple memory-aware construction orders are used, followed by relocation and swap refinement while preserving strict lexicographic improvement.
